infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SurveyQs uses your location to record where each interview took place, when the survey requires it.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SurveyQs uses the camera to capture required photos and scan barcodes during an interview.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: SurveyQs uses Face ID to unlock the app quickly so you don't have to type your password every time.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow SurveyQs to record where each interview took place.

plugins.faceIDPermission: SurveyQs uses Face ID to unlock the app quickly.
